svg.text: entry: a way in: public, and nothing in this file calls it
api: public, and also used inside this file
dashed: a call that goes back up, or across a wrapped rank
The functions studio.rs defines, and the calls between them. An edge means the
callee's name appears, called, inside the caller's body: a syntactic reading, not a
type-resolved one. 22 of 32 are drawn, so the picture stays readable.
